notes.title: Dominari Empires - Now Released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're pleased to announce that we've now left Early Access, and Dominari Empires is now available... and on sale! [b]Enjoy a 20% discount[/b] to celebrate our launch week!

Happy conquering!

Tiny RTS

notes.title: Updated Game Name - New Challenges
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

As you've likely noticed, we've changed the name of the game to better reflect the nature of the conflict along with updated graphics and video trailer.

With this update, we've also added in a few more single-player challenges for veterans who are routinely crushing level 10 AI.

All of this is in preparation for us to move out of Early Access very soon!

Enjoy and happy conquering!

notes.title: Single Player Challenges Have Arrived!
notes.content:
April 15th, 2018

Latest update notes!

[list]
[*]Added new CHALLENGES mode
[*]Added challenge: Defenders of the Federation
[*]Added challenge: The Armada
[*]Added challenge: Blitz
[/list]

Happy conquering!
Tiny RTS

notes.title: Orbital Graphics Update (and more)
notes.content:
We're pleased to share another update with some pretty cool graphics updates, updates to features, and of course some bug fixes. Thanks to everyone in Discord for reporting bugs and sharing ideas!

[list]
[*]Added new Orbital Placement guidance graphics
[*]Can now chat after a game for up to 60 seconds
[*]New Stryker Sound Effect (now different than EPIM)
[*]Multiple fixes for multi-select box highlighting
[*]Additional logging for file i/o errors
[*]Various instruction updates
[*]Various ability description updates for consistency
[*]Animation fixes
[/list]

Happy conquering!
Tiny RTS

notes.title: March Madness Build
notes.content:
March 25th, 2018

Latest update notes!

[list]
[*]Starbases under construction no longer highlight for ability hovers
[*]Starbases no longer show resource indicators.
[*]Tutorial container incorrect overlays with defect/victory fixed.
[*]New Stryker Explosions
[*]Updates to ODS tutorial to clarify some of the finer points.
[*]Single route selection now shows whole path to target enemy/friendly planet
[*]Right mouse click now deselects an ability that has been selected
[*]Additional updates to instructions to clarify a few things
[*]Fix for sequential mappings game option not saving
[*]Tutorials now show hotkey based on key bindings selection
[*]Multi-planet select can now be started outside of the HUD screen
[*]New turret placement animation
[*]Level 3 abilities will no longer show as upgradable
[/list]

Happy conquering!
Tiny RTS

notes.title: Dominari Tournament - Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
If you are loving Dominari Tournament, you can now let your friends know that there is a [b]free demo for download[/b] on the store page.

The demo lasts for one hour, plenty of time to try out the tutorials and a few levels.

We could also use your help! If you can share on your favorite social apps, we definitely appreciate it. Our community is growing slowly, but surely, and every share helps!

Thanks!

Tiny RTS

notes.title: Dominari Tournament - "Invite Steam Friends" Update and More!
notes.content:
March 12th, 2018

Hey everyone,

Massive update today! Here it goes:

What's New:
- "Invite Steam Friend" feature ([b]only works if your friend is in-game[/b])
- Added animations for Recruit, Salvage, and FTL
- Added Player nameplates to top of inteface so you can see who you are playing
- Added ping information to nameplates
- Improved route drawing, provides more clarity on fighter pathing
- Added option for alternate key-binding (QWERTY mode)

[b]We'll be unlocking multi-player @ 4:30pm CST.[/b]

Thanks!
Tiny RTS Team

notes.title: Dominari Tournament - What are we working on?
notes.content:
Hey 4X/RTS Hybrid Commanders,

We are working furiously on adding the ability to invite your Steam friends to a private 1v1 match. We hope to get this out in the next 24 hours!

With that update will come new animations for Recruit Fighters, Salvage, and FTL as well as improved drawing for fighter route lines during multi-select.

Hang tight!

[img]http://i.cubeupload.com/5rdSX0.png[/img]

notes.title: Dominari Tournament released!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

At 9am PST we released Dominari Tournament into Early Access. Thanks for joining us and we hope that you will share with us your ideas (and the occasional bug you find) so that we can make the game great for the official release sometime in the future.

We love chatting on Discord, so please join us there if you have any questions!

[url=https://discord.gg/pTqgWug]Dominari Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Dominari Tournament will release on March 8th
notes.content:
Yes, it is official! We'll be releasing Dominari Tournament into Early Access on March 8th, something we've been looking forward to for a very long time.

Our servers are ready to go, though we'll continue to do performance testing leading up to launch day.

For those of you who already have keys, we'd ask for you to join us on March 8th the welcome new players as they start learning the game and help out in Discord to share strategy, ideas, and troubleshooting for any issues.

Other than that, for us the hard part is waiting... 4 days seems like an eternity to us. It will not get here soon enough!

notes.title: Early Access 0.2018.02.20 Build
notes.content:
This release is our Early Access candidate that contains the new home planet explosion when you lose it (and the game) as well as numerous bug fixes.

Assuming we don't run into any critical defects, this should be the release we go out with very soon to the rest of the world.

a HUGE thank you to all of our playtesters for helping us shape this for Early Access. We've implemented countless ideas that you've shared and definitely appreciate all of the bugs you have found (especially those hard to find ones).

Go forth and crush your enemies, commander!

notes.title: Updated 0.2018.01.15 Alpha Build
notes.content:
A big thank you to everyone sending in bugs/crashes as you find them!

[h1]First new release of the year, here is what is included:[/h1]
[list]
[*]In Single-Player, accessing Menu now pauses the game.
[*]Fixed reference graphics in Tutorial.
[*]Fixed bug when switching from full-screen to windowed.
[*]Fixed bug that crashed the game in certain situations on window minimization.
[*]Fixed bug that crashed game when having Steam names with unsupported characters.
[*]Updated explosions animations.
[/list]

Go forth and crush your enemies, commander.

notes.title: Happy New Year - 0.2017.12.31 Release
notes.content:
We've just posted a new Alpha build. Check it out!

[list]
[*]New Options - Windowed Mode
[*]New Options - Game music Volume
[*]New Music - Now randomly chooses between 2 songs
[*]Stryker and Missile levels now render differently for each level
[*]Main Menu now shows players online, matches played
[*]Now shows possible missile destinations
[*]New Upgrade State Cursor
[*]Added pathing clarity on multi-select
[*]When dropping Starbase, you can see what it can reach
[*]Other bug fixes
[/list]

Please report any bugs in our Discord channel!
